steps.title: Three steps to a catalog listing

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.desc: With Google or a link sent to your email — no passwords. It takes less than a minute.

fill.title: Fill in the application
fill.desc: Name, category, description, contacts and 4 to 10 photos of your work. About 5–10 minutes.

review.title: We review and publish
review.desc: Usually within 1–2 days. If anything needs fixing, we'll leave a comment right in your account.

benefits.title: Everything couples need to find you

page.title: Your own page
page.desc: Photos of your work, description, areas you serve and contacts — in three languages.

leads.title: Requests from couples
leads.desc: Couples send a request with their wedding date right from your page.

contacts.title: One-click contacts
contacts.desc: Phone, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram and website — no extra steps.

stats.title: Interest analytics
stats.desc: We count how many couples opened your contacts, followed your links and sent requests.

pricing.title: 3 months free
pricing.free: For the first three months your listing is free — no conditions or commitments.
pricing.after: After that, the price depends on your listing's analytics: how much interest couples showed. Before the free period ends, we'll get in touch, show you the numbers and discuss terms.

cost.q: How much does a listing cost?
cost.a: The first 3 months are free. After that, the price depends on your listing's analytics; before the free period ends, we'll show you the stats and discuss terms.

time.q: How long does the review take?
time.a: Usually 1–2 days. Your application status and our reply are shown in your account.

edit.q: Can I change my listing later?
edit.a: Yes. You send changes from your account and they appear on the site after review; until then the current version stays.

noTime.q: No time to fill in the application?
noTime.a: Message us on WhatsApp, Telegram or Instagram: send photos of your work and a few words about yourself, and we'll set up your listing.

photos.a: 4 to 10 of your best works, at least 800 px on the short side. JPG, PNG, WebP and iPhone HEIC all work. The first photo becomes the cover.

categories.q: I work in two fields. Do I need two listings?
categories.a: No: in the application you can choose a main and one additional category, for example photo and video.

AboutPage.title: Taran Taran — Armenia’s wedding marketplace
AboutPage.description: A directory of vetted wedding vendors across Armenia — portfolios and contacts right on the listing, no endless back-and-forth in DMs.

story.p1: Planning a wedding in Armenia usually means asking around and messaging a dozen people — a venue, a photographer, a decorator, a toastmaster, a dress — each one needing the same questions answered separately. Taran Taran brings vendors together in one directory, with a portfolio and contacts right on the card.

portfolio.title: Portfolio on the card
portfolio.desc: Past work, a description and contacts are right on the vendor page — no need to DM just to see whether they fit.

direct.title: No booking fees
direct.desc: You pay nothing for booking — not to us, and nothing on top of the vendor's price. Vendors pay us for their listing.

vetted.title: Listings are reviewed by hand
vetted.desc: Every vendor application is checked before it goes live — no random listings in the catalog.

AboutPage.roadmap: Taran Taran works across Armenia: Yerevan and ten regions.

FaqPage.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about Taran Taran: contacting vendors, sending requests and getting listed in the directory.
FaqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqPage.description: How Taran Taran works for couples and for vendors. Can't find an answer? Message us.

cost.q: How much does it cost to use Taran Taran?
cost.a: It's free for couples. We don't charge a booking fee and add nothing to the vendor's price.

contact.q: How do I contact a vendor?
contact.a: On the vendor's page, press “Show contacts” to see their phone number and social media. Or press “Send a request”, enter your name, phone number and date, and your request will go to the vendor.

afterRequest.q: What happens after I send a request?
afterRequest.a: Your request goes to the vendor, who then gets in touch with you — by phone, or on WhatsApp or Telegram if you ticked them in the form.

noReply.q: The vendor isn't replying. What should I do?
noReply.a: Message us via the <contacts>contacts page</contacts> — we'll suggest who else to contact.

booking.q: Can I book and pay for services through the site?
booking.a: No. You agree the price, contract, deposit and all other details directly with the vendor. We don't accept payment for their services.

vetting.a: We review every listing before publishing it: contact details, description and portfolio. The vendor is responsible for the quality of their services, though, so look through their work and sign a contract before booking.

regions.a: Yes. The <catalog>directory</catalog> has a filter by region, and many vendors work across Armenia — it's noted on their listings.

discount.q: Is it true I can get a discount?
discount.a: Yes: tell the vendor you found them on Taran Taran — many vendors offer a discount for it. Check the amount and terms with the vendor.

data.a: The name and phone number from your request are used only so that the vendor you chose can contact you, and are kept for 12 months. See the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for details.

join.a: Message us on <whatsapp>WhatsApp</whatsapp>. We'll set up your listing from your photos and description, review it and publish it.

price.q: How much does a listing cost?
price.a: Listing is paid. The price and period depend on your category — message us and we'll send you the terms.

leads.a: Couples call and message you using the contacts on your listing. Requests sent through the site reach you via a messenger, with the couple's name, phone number and event date.

edit.a: Yes. Send us new photos, a new description or new contact details and we'll update your listing.

advertising.q: Do you offer advertising beyond the listing?
advertising.a: Yes: an article about you on the blog, a mention in a relevant article or a banner on the site. See the <advertise>advertising section</advertise> for details.

stats.q: Can I find out how many enquiries I've had?
stats.a: Yes. We count how often your contacts were opened and your links followed, and how many requests came through the site. Message us and we'll send you the numbers.

cta.title: Didn't find an answer?
cta.desc: Message us and we'll reply during working hours.

afterPublish.title: What you get after publishing

afterPublish.edit: You can change the invitation at any time: edits appear at the same link right away. Unpublishing or deleting it takes a couple of taps too.
afterPublish.replies: Guests reply right on the page: whether they're coming and how many of them. All replies gather in your account, and you can download them as a spreadsheet.
